name: structural-scanner-crate
body: The `src/structlib` crate and its `structfrontend` binary: the single self-contained Rust artifact that walks a checkout, claims the structural files, and streams their `File`/`Struct`/`contains` records. It superseded and absorbed the now-retired `src/mdlib` Markdown frontend: the former `rust.mdfrontend` no longer exists as code or as graph nodes, and today the `md` stream id for Markdown is served by `structlib` (the Markdown parser lives in `rust.structfrontend.md`). No scan-time toolchain, no external runtime, no engine pin beyond its crates.
